rules.rule: Preserve weather, biology and mixed useful echo; distinguish target identity from the action to take.
Do not delete solely from low RHOHV, unusual ZDR, weak reflectivity or near-zero radial velocity.
Audit persistent maps for learned biological signal and inspect temporal velocity evidence.
Distinguish raw-signal filtering or recovery from censoring already archived moments.
Treat independent instrument evidence, expert labels, assistant interpretations and proxy labels as different provenance classes.
Match wavelength, transmit mode, resolution, noise calibration and available fields before transferring thresholds.
A detector response is not a calibrated probability or a complete cleaning policy.
Use field-specific decoding so false flags, no detection, nodata and unsupported scope remain distinguishable.
Freeze development and acceptance events separately; do not split neighbouring gates as independent cases.
Report retention, artefact removal, uncertainty and coverage by class and mode, with a retain-everything control.
Inspect rare structural damage and downstream measurements as well as gate percentages.
Escalate ambiguous mixtures for additional evidence; never manufacture source-first or independent labels.
Combining detectors creates a new candidate and requires its own validation.
Monitor scientific effects after activation as well as job completion.
